exposure: hospital type (teaching government vs. non-governmental MCH)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery in 2011 at three teaching government and three private MCH hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in non-governmental hospitals (48.3%) compared to teaching government hospitals (31.1%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in teaching hospitals compared to non-governmental hospitals.
